facts.fact: The National Institute of Statistics reports that the system shows 356,838 births and 39,355 deaths that occurred and were registered in 2025, and that divorces are registered into the NCI_CRVS system.

systems.tiers: national; holds registered births, deaths, marriages and divorces, and causes of death from health facilities and from verbal autopsy in communities

note: The page says events are registered into the system but not where the entry is made or by how many offices; its completeness rates (births 92.9%, deaths 50.5% in 2025) are shares of events, not of offices.
